categories: Azure Bot 资源与频道管理
Azure Bot resource and channel management
name: azure-mgmt-botservice-dotnet
summary: 微软的 .NET 示例展示了如何在资源组中按名称查找现有的 Azure Bot，并配置 Direct Line、Microsoft Teams 和 Web Chat 等频道。先在 .NET 项目中添加 Azure.ResourceManager.BotService 和 Azure.Identity。该 SDK 的适用范围是通过 Azure 管理平面配置机器人资源和频道。

Microsoft’s .NET examples show how to look up an existing Azure Bot by name in a resource group and configure channels such as Direct Line, Microsoft Teams, and Web Chat. Start by adding Azure.ResourceManager.BotService and Azure.Identity to your .NET project. The SDK covers Azure resource and channel configuration through the management plane.
